scripts.bump:patch: v=$(npm version patch --no-git-tag-version) && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const pkg=require("./package.json"); const p="src-tauri/tauri.conf.json"; const t=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p)); if(t.package){t.package.version=pkg.version;}else{t.version=pkg.version;} fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(t, null, 2) + "\n");' && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const pkg=require("./package.json"); const p="src-tauri/Cargo.toml"; let c=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"); c=c.replace(/^version = ".*?"/m, "version = \"" + pkg.version + "\""); fs.writeFileSync(p, c);' && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && git add package.json package-lock.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/Cargo.toml src-tauri/Cargo.lock && git commit -m "$v" && git tag "$v"
